ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_006_cost_margin_normalized
ir.intuition: Normalize the cost gap by weighted mean absolute gap to reduce sensitivity to scale and maintain stable margin effects.
ir.pseudocode:
gap_raw = cost_b - cost_a
mean_abs_gap = sum(weight * abs(gap_raw)) / (sum(weight) + eps)
normalized_gap = gap_raw / (mean_abs_gap + eps)
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - cost_gap_coef * normalized_gap + margin, -20, 20)
loss = -weight * logsigmoid(x)
result = sum(loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    scale = float(extra.get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    margin_factor = float(extra.get('margin_factor', 0.1))
    cost_gap_coef = float(extra.get('cost_gap_coef', 0.15))
    cost_a = batch['cost_a']
    cost_b = batch['cost_b']
    gap_raw = cost_b - cost_a
    mean_abs_gap = ops.sum(weight * ops.abs(gap_raw)) / (ops.sum(weight) + eps)
    normalized_gap = gap_raw / (mean_abs_gap + eps)
    margin = margin_factor * scale
    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - cost_gap_coef * normalized_gap + margin
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -weight * ops.logsigmoid(x)
    return ops.sum(loss) / (ops.sum(weight) + eps)
